questions.prompt: Which of these are dwarf planets?
questions.fact: Ceres sits in the asteroid belt and is the only dwarf planet inside Neptune's orbit. The others are moons.

questions.prompt: Which of these animals are marsupials?
questions.fact: Wombat droppings are cube-shaped, which stops them rolling off the rocks and logs they mark.

questions.prompt: How long does sunlight take to reach Earth, in minutes?
questions.fact: About 8 minutes 20 seconds. From the next nearest star it takes more than four years.

questions.prompt: How fast can a cheetah run, in km/h?
questions.fact: Around 110 km/h in a short burst, and 0 to 100 in about three seconds, quicker than most sports cars.

questions.prompt: What is the largest animal that has ever lived?
questions.fact: A blue whale's heart is the size of a small car and beats as slowly as twice a minute on a deep dive.

questions.prompt: Which planet spins on its side?
questions.hint: Each of its seasons lasts about 21 years.
questions.fact: Uranus is tilted 98 degrees, so each pole gets 42 years of sunlight followed by 42 years of dark.
